Container.Name: backuparr
Container.Overview: Backup your Arrs. Scheduled config/database backups for Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr, Whisparr, Prowlarr, Profilarr, Bazarr, Tdarr, SABnzbd, NZBGet, Tautulli, Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and Seerr, sent to every destination you enable: Local storage, Google Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox. Apps, destinations, schedule, retention and restores are all set up in the web UI. Most apps are backed up through their own API, so they need only a URL (your server's IP and the app's port) and an API key. Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and Seerr also need their folder mapped below, and Bazarr needs its backup folder only to restore. Leave the paths for apps you don't use empty. Docs: https://rsaturns.github.io/backuparr/
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: arr radarr sonarr lidarr whisparr prowlarr bazarr sabnzbd nzbget plex jellyfin emby seerr tautulli rclone restore

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port of the Backuparr web UI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Backuparr's settings, encrypted credentials and, with the Local destination, the backups themselves. Back this folder up or keep a cloud destination enabled.

Config.Name: Jellyfin backups folder
Config.Description: Needed to back up Jellyfin: the folder Jellyfin writes its backups to, e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/jellyfin/data/data/backups for the linuxserver image. See https://rsaturns.github.io/backuparr/apps/jellyfin/

Config.Name: Emby config folder
Config.Description: Needed to back up Emby: the folder Emby has at /config, e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/emby. Set Access Mode to Read/Write to restore from the web UI. See https://rsaturns.github.io/backuparr/apps/emby/

Config.Name: Plex data folder
Config.Description: Needed to back up Plex: its Plex Media Server folder, e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/plex/Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server. Set Access Mode to Read/Write to restore from the web UI. See https://rsaturns.github.io/backuparr/apps/plex/

Config.Name: Seerr config folder
Config.Description: Needed to back up Seerr: the folder Seerr has at /app/config, e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/seerr. Set Access Mode to Read/Write to restore from the web UI. See https://rsaturns.github.io/backuparr/apps/seerr/

Config.Name: Bazarr backup folder
Config.Description: Needed only to restore Bazarr: its backup folder, e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/bazarr/backup. See https://rsaturns.github.io/backuparr/apps/bazarr/

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the container runs as. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions of new files. The default 077 lets only the container user read backups; set 022 if another user reads the backup folder.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Logging level for backup and restore runs, e.g. DEBUG.

Config.Name: BACKUPARR_FORCE_HTTPS
Config.Description: Set to true only behind your own TLS reverse proxy. Leave empty on plain HTTP, or login fails. See https://rsaturns.github.io/backuparr/environment-variables/

Config.Name: BACKUPARR_TRUSTED_PROXY
Config.Description: With BACKUPARR_FORCE_HTTPS: your reverse proxy's IP address, so the login lockout sees each client's own address.

Config.Name: BACKUPARR_DISABLE_AUTH
Config.Description: Set to true only when an authenticating reverse proxy protects the whole UI and the port isn't reachable any other way. See https://rsaturns.github.io/backuparr/security/

Config.Name: BACKUPARR_SECRETS_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: replaces the generated secrets.key that encrypts credentials in config.json. Leave empty to use the generated key.

Config.Name: RCLONE_CONFIG_PASS
Config.Description: Optional: replaces the generated password that encrypts rclone.conf. Leave empty to use the generated one.
